notes.title: Dungeon content update is coming!
notes.content:
I've been quite for a few weeks, working as hard as I can to get more content out for everyone!

I just wanted to let you know, that Dungeon 1 is complete and currently undergoing testing before I upload the build to steam for everyone to check out! 

What does this mean? This means that some of the item combos that you've enjoyed so far will be going away (I'll be adding a code you can enter to get them back most likely) and that you can finally start experiencing the progression of the game as it's intended to be. 

You'll enter the game with no items currently, and you'll have to find and enter the dungeon and solve it's puzzles in order to start getting your items back. 

The dungeon is currently 5 new areas, not including a secret area, and Boss room. 
As soon as it's tested and I'm confident that everyone will be able to play it well enough (I'm sure some of you will still find bugs for me to fix) I will be uploading the build!

When the build goes live, I will of course update everyone here!

notes.title: There's Cheat codes in Sword 'N' Board?!
notes.content:
Yep! And though I've shared it a bit on my stream on Twitch, I've yet to share it here. I've actually left a riddle about it in a previous update, but I thought now was the time to finally let everyone in on the little secret!

To enter the cheat codes, you have to first be in the game (not just in the start menu, but in the actual overworld) and hit escape (or pause if you're using a controller) to bring up the "Main Menu". Once that is up, use your keyboard to type in any of the following cheat codes! 

[b](Hidden, because... spoilers)[/b]

[spoiler] 
[list]
    [*][b]better[/b] - Upgrades Sidd's "Attack" to level 6!
    [*][b]harder[/b] - Upgrades Sidd's "Defense" to level 6!
    [*][b]faster[/b] - Upgrades Sidd's "Agility" to level 6!
    [*][b]stronger[/b] - Upgrades Sidd's "Stamina" to level 6!
    [*][b]lucky[/b] - Upgrades Sidd's "Luck" to level 6!
    [*][b]bombs[/b] - Give Sidd 999 bombs.
    [*][b]marbles[/b] - Give Sidd 999 marbles.
    [*][b]2dheroes[/b] - Teleport to the Blacksmith!
    [*][b]sidd mode[/b] - Upgrade all of Sidd's stats to level 6
    [*][b]inventory[/b] - add 20 of each non-forged item to Sidd's Inventory
    [*] Using the arrow keys on your keyboard: [b]up,up,down,down,left,right,left,right, b, a [/b] - Upgrade all of Sidd's Stats and give him 999 Marbles and 999 bombs

[/list]
[/spoiler] 

I thought these would be a good thing to have in the game to help everyone test things, and to also just kind of allow everyone to have more fun with things as they play the game. Not to mention, far too many games have stopped using cheat codes!

notes.title: New Build = Cardboard Sword + Bomb combo & something secret...
notes.content:
A new build is live, and you will now have access to the Cardboard Sword + Bomb combo ability!

[b]What this new ability will allow you to do:[/b]
[list]
    [*]Jump over/through [b]some[/b] objects and help traverse terrain!
    [*]Freeze enemies briefly (only when Sidd is in mid-air).
    [*]Creates a [b]powerful[/b] 8 point explosion around Sidd!
    [*]Can be used to set terrain on fire, causing other nearby enemies to take damage from the resulting flames!
[/list]

There is also something hidden in the game, but there are some [b]strings[/b] attached to finding them! They may not be the [b]type[/b] of secrets that you all are used to, but I know you all have the keys to find them! 

I may be less cryptic later on... maybe even on stream tomorrow!

notes.title: New Build = Enemy AI refined & Windowed mode!
notes.content:
Okay, so I've made a bunch of changes today, which I said would be put up today on Stream, so I thought I'd roll out the new build, and let you all know what to expect!

First, is [b] Windowed mode[/b]! I know a few people have wanted it, so they can play it on a monitor of their choosing (before the game liked to randomly select a monitor to play on). To access Windowed mode simply press: [b] Alt+Enter[/b] with the game open! It should then go from fullscreen, to windowed!

[b]"Fecals"[/b] have been added to the game! (You wanted poop monsters, you got poop monsters!)

Readable signs have been reworked and should fix a lot of the issues that would happen previously where the sign wouldn't open correctly, or the top UI wouldn't disappear as intended. 

And lastly [b]Enemy AI has been refined![/b]. The current enemy AI that can be found in the game will work slightly different from enemy to enemy, but can be broken down currently to 4 basic types. Those types are:

[list]
    [*][b]Passive:[/b] These enemies will wander aimlessly until struck by Sidd's cardboard sword, and will then run away. (no enemies currently use this, but it will be used very soon!)
    [*][b]Passive Aggressive:[/b] These enemies have a real issue with being direct, and try to avoid conflct for the most part. They will wander around until you attack them, and then they will chase after you until you get out of range. (Feclets do this currently)
    [*][b]Aggressive:[/b] These enemies want to be on you, no matter what. If you get too close, they'll take that as a "sign" that you were trying to flirt with them, and will spend the rest of your time in the area annoying you until you leave or kill them! (Jack 0's currently have this behavior)
    [*][b]Chicken $#!t:[/b] These enemies have a huge fear of commitment, and will run if you decide you're ready to get close to them. Probably not the best Valentine in the world, though I hear Fecals have attachment issues (is that a pun?!). (Maggo's currently have this behavior).
[/list]

Drop rates have also been adjusted slightly, so items are a little less abundant. Item drops are still being worked on, so if you see less and less of things, it's probably not a bug!

Until the next update, go have fun, and go kill some poops!

notes.title: New build is live!
notes.content:
A new update is live for Sword 'N' Board. Further optimization has been made to the game and more optimization will continue to be made as well! Some things the current build focuses on:

[list]
    [*]Added controls to the menus (this is still being added to and refined)
    [*]Bug fixes for controls and combining items in hopes of reducing an "auto fire" bug that has been reported.
    [*]Further control refinement. 
    [*]Fixed the issue that was causing the main menu to be unresponsive when start was pressed
    [*]Added a new overworld area to the game, as well as a new secret area to be found!

[/list]

I am also working on some camera bugs as well so I can give you all back control over the resolution that you would like to use. I know some people have reported an issue with the game essentially picking what monitor to display on, and not being able to run the game as they wish. So I'll be refining the camera and working on proper scaling so I can give you back resolution choices, and working on a "Settings menu" for the game as well.

The next update will focus on those resolution troubles, as well as further working on controls and refactoring various things to reduce animation bugs while attacking/shooting.

Have fun, and find those secrets!
